tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: HFCs shall transparently disclose to the borrower all information about fees/ charges payable for processing the loan application, the amount of fees refundable if loan amount is not sanctioned/disbursed, pre-payment options and charges, if any, penal charges for delayed repayment, if any, conversion charges for switching loan from fixed to floating rates or vice-versa, existence of any interest reset clause and any other matter which affects the interest of the borrower.

tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: In other words, HFCs must disclose ‘all in cost’ inclusive of all charges involved in processing/sanctioning of loan application in a transparent manner.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: It should also be ensured that such charges/fees are non-discriminatory.
